name: How do multigenerational homes handle parking needs?

mainEntity.name: How do multigenerational homes handle parking needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extra driveways, carports, or tandem parking accommodate multiple vehicles; converted garages often require one replacement uncovered space per bay.
